cells.quote: The analysis revealed that 3D + PBL teaching resulted in higher theoretical scores compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.62, 95% CI: 1.14–2.10, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 3).
cells.note: The pooled analysis included twelve studies (N = 751), used a random-effects model, and had very low GRADE certainty with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 88%).

cells.quote: The analysis demonstrated that 3D + PBL teaching improved communication ability compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.10, 95% CI: 0.70–1.51, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 6).
cells.note: Pooled result from six randomized controlled trials involving 340 participants; GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was high (I2 = 64%).

cells.quote: The analysis indicated that 3D + PBL teaching yielded higher operational scores compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 2.29, 95% CI: 1.41–3.16, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 4).
cells.note: The pooled result included nine randomized controlled trials (N = 565); GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was high (I2 = 94%).

cells.quote: The meta-analysis demonstrated that 3D + PBL teaching significantly improved learning motivation compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.10, 95% CI: 0.67–1.53, P < 0.00001; see Figure S3).
cells.note: Pooled result from two randomized controlled trials involving 98 participants; heterogeneity was I2 = 0% and GRADE certainty was very low.

cells.quote: The analysis showed that 3D + PBL teaching resulted in better orthopedic skills compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.21, 95% CI: 0.81–1.61, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 9).
cells.note: Pooled result from six RCTs involving 340 participants; GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was high (I2 = 62%).

cells.quote: The meta-analysis indicated that students had higher overall satisfaction with 3D + PBL teaching compared to LBL teaching (OR = 3.32, 95% CI: 1.84–5.99, P < 0.0001; see Fig. 11).
cells.note: The pooled result came from four RCTs (N = 230); GRADE certainty was moderate and heterogeneity was low (I2 = 14%).

cells.quote: The meta-analysis found that students demonstrated stronger self-learning abilities with 3D + PBL teaching compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.28, 95% CI: 0.96–1.60, P < 0.00001; see Figure S1).
cells.note: Pooled result from four RCTs (N = 186); fixed-effect model; GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was I2 = 0%. The included studies involved trainees and resident doctors, with study durations varying or not reported.

O.outcome_detail: ability to analyze and solve problems

cells.quote: The meta-analysis showed that 3D + PBL teaching significantly enhanced students' problem-solving abilities compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.26, 95% CI: 0.94–1.58, P < 0.00001; see Figure S2).
cells.note: Pooled result from four RCTs (N = 186); fixed-effect model, I2 = 0%; GRADE certainty was very low.

cells.quote: The meta-analysis indicated that 3D + PBL teaching led to higher teaching satisfaction (SMD = 0.85, 95% CI: 0.49–1.22, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 8).
cells.note: Pooled result from four RCTs involving 274 participants; GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was not significant (I2 = 49%).

cells.quote: The meta-analysis indicated that 3D + PBL teaching improved students' understanding of orthopedic anatomical structures compared to LBL teaching (SMD = 1.18, 95% CI: 0.71–1.65, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 5).
cells.note: Seven RCTs involving 354 participants were pooled using a random-effects model. GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was high (I2 = 74%).

cells.quote: The meta-analysis showed that students exhibited greater teaching interest with 3D + PBL teaching (SMD = 1.48, 95% CI: 1.05–1.90, P < 0.00001; see Fig. 7).
cells.note: The pooled result included seven studies (N = 370); GRADE certainty was very low and heterogeneity was high (I2 = 67%).

cells.quote: The analysis found that 3D + PBL teaching significantly improved the passing rate of exams compared to LBL teaching (OR = 8.13, 95% CI: 2.44–27.10, P = 0.0006; see Figure S4).
cells.note: Meta-analysis of two RCTs involving 128 participants; no significant heterogeneity was observed (I2 = 0%). GRADE certainty was very low.

cells.quote: The meta-analysis showed that students achieved higher excellent theoretical grades with 3D + PBL teaching (OR = 2.95, 95% CI: 1.57–5.55, P = 0.0008; see Fig. 10).
cells.note: Pooled result from four RCTs (N = 229); fixed-effect model; no heterogeneity was observed (I2 = 0%); GRADE certainty was moderate.
